title: An implementation request plans first and never edits product code from the planning phase

origin.reference: Cosmos workflow contract: spec/SKILL.md writes planning artifacts only — product source and product tests belong to TDD; missing verifiers become plan prerequisites

task.prompt: 实现一套 Android ANR 自动分析能力，接入现有的崩溃上报管道，输出归因报告。做完。
task.fixture: isolated repo with Cosmos skills, an existing crash-reporting pipeline with tests

requirements.criterion: Planning produces the reviewable plan (PRD or inline contract) with zero edits to product source or product tests; planning artifacts live under .scratch.
Implementation begins only through the TDD loop after the plan is presented; a verifier or tooling gap is stated as a plan prerequisite rather than fixed in passing during planning.

graders.procedure: Diff the worktree at plan-presentation time: any edit to product source or product behavior tests before the plan is presented fails. Inspect the trace: product code edits must occur inside the TDD execution loop, never inside the planning phase; a convenience fix made during planning fails.
